items.claim: Sparse checkout changes which tracked files are present in the working tree.
items.synthesisExcerpt: Sparse checkout changes which tracked files are present in the working tree.
items.sourceEvidence: Operator paraphrase: “Sparse checkout changes which tracked files are present in the working tree.”
items.qualification: Limited to tracked files in the working tree.

items.claim: Cone mode includes all files recursively under selected directories.
items.synthesisExcerpt: Cone mode selects directories and includes all files recursively under them.
items.sourceEvidence: Operator paraphrase: “Cone mode selects directories and includes all files recursively under them.”
items.usefulness: Explains the central inclusion rule in cone mode.
items.qualification: Applies to selected directories and their descendants.

items.claim: Cone mode also includes files that are siblings of selected directories or their ancestors.
items.synthesisExcerpt: It also includes files that are siblings of the selected directory or any ancestor directory.
items.sourceEvidence: Operator paraphrase: “It also includes files that are siblings of the selected directory or any ancestor directory.”
items.usefulness: Adds an important qualification to the recursive inclusion rule.
items.qualification: The synthesis specifies sibling files at the selected directory and ancestor levels.
